title: Lane worktree creation wedges when the shared clone's HEAD dangles — heal it to the default branch
body:
## Problem

stSoftwareAU/GRQ-AutoTrader keeps failing at setup with fast failures across the fleet (tally issue stSoftwareAU/GRQ-AutoTrader#3184). The marker records:

`setup after 18s: Failed to set up repo stSoftwareAU/GRQ-AutoTrader: Could not create a s1 worktree ... fatal: invalid reference: HEAD`

`ensureLaneWorktree` creates lane worktrees with `git worktree add --detach --force <path> HEAD` (`worker/deno/lib/lane_worktree.ts`), so the operation resolves through the shared clone's HEAD symref. When that symref points at a branch that no longer exists locally, the worktree add fails permanently — every cycle dies in phase `setup` inside a minute and releases the claim with no PR, and nothing self-heals.

Observed live: GRQ-23's clone of GRQ-AutoTrader has HEAD pointing at `milestone/3127-web-pwa-refresh` — milestone sync checks the milestone branch out of the main clone and leaves it there. Whatever later removes the local branch (cleanup, a clone recreation under the worktrees, a sibling host's sync) leaves HEAD dangling, and the lane then cannot create any worktree.

## Proposal

Mirror the Issue #1561 orphan-directory repair: when `git worktree add ... HEAD` fails with the invalid-reference shape, heal the clone's HEAD to the repo's default branch and retry once:

- Resolve the default branch from the clone itself — `git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` (the same local resolution `git_push.ts` already uses, no network).
- If `refs/heads/<default>` exists locally: `git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/<default>`.
- Otherwise: `git checkout -B <default> origin/<default>` (creates it from the remote-tracking ref).
- Retry the worktree add once. A failure for any other reason keeps today's behaviour, and the heal itself failing reports the original error with the heal failure attached.

## Evidence

- Marker on stSoftwareAU/GRQ-AutoTrader#3184 (host `vibe-coder-84241-664b4163`, 2026-10-11T14:09Z): `fatal: invalid reference: HEAD`.
- Live clone state on GRQ-23: `cat .git/HEAD` → `ref: refs/heads/milestone/3127-web-pwa-refresh` (a milestone branch — the clone's HEAD is left wherever milestone sync checked out).
